question: The price of fuel decreases by 40%, 30% and 10% in three successive months, but increases by 40% in the fourth month. What is the percentage increase/decrease in the price of fuel in the fourth month as compared to its original price?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the multiplying factor method for successive percentage changes:

Final factor = (1 − 0.40) × (1 − 0.30) × (1 − 0.10) × (1 + 0.40)

⇒ Final factor = 0.6 × 0.7 × 0.9 × 1.4 = 0.5292

⇒ Net decrease = 1 − 0.5292 = 0.4708

⇒ Net percentage decrease = 47.08%

**∴ The correct answer is 47.08% decrease.**
